scheme_name: Promotion And Development Of Tea Tourism Infrastructure In Assam
other_conditions: Applicant must be a private tea garden company owner, or a leaseholder with a lease period of at least 15 years from the date of application.
The tea garden must have a minimum area of 50 hectares (or 25 hectares in hill districts).
The tea garden must be free from any disputes, encroachments, and industrial pollution.
The applicant must be willing to undertake the tea tourism scheme.
benefits_summary: The scheme upgrades tourism infrastructure of tea gardens, creates employment opportunities and boosts the rural economy of Assam.
